generate_mask: generate a binary mask video from an input video file using background subtraction
generate_binary_masks: generate binary masks for all mp4 videos in an input directory and save to output directory
run_binary_mask_generator_cli: run the binary mask generator CLI with input and output parent directories and optional threshold
create_roi_masks_real_video: create binary ROI masks for real videos with a custom threshold value
create_roi_masks_generated_video: create binary ROI masks for generated videos with a custom threshold value
